decision: Approve the scene-social convention for a scene's social-profile links group.

evidence.interpretation: The owner approved the naming convention in gate 3 of the Hero v0.1 plan. The whole-file plan SHA-256 is 11906914c6cc8b6f5eddade2a14a3f3415061727408e4e03c34e09901de8eb82; the exact entry text is in section 5. Not native review authority.

convention.name: social
convention.meaning: An optional consumer-supplied social-profile links group in a scene organism.
convention.whenToUse: Supply a named social-profile links group within a scene, such as SocialLinks.
convention.avoid: Do not use for CTA controls, a structured data array or a generic navigation landmark.
